entries.name: The Inquisition's Two Minds
entries.description: Inside the inquisitorial halls two habits argue endlessly without a schism: file every unquiet witness, or burn the page cleanly before the stairs.

entries.name: The Office of Seals
entries.description: Wardens and clerks of the stamped writ split between stamping only what stands true and stamping whatever keeps passage open.

entries.name: The Readers' Circles
entries.description: Cellar study-groups copying torn marginalia; half urge wide sharing across sanctuaries, half keep the leaves locked under oath.

entries.name: The Guild and the Ring
entries.description: Artisans, smelters, and Back-Court repairers weighing whether honest brass weights can survive false-sun taxation.

entries.name: The Cellar and the Street
entries.description: Guides of unrecorded tunnels divided over keeping out of the census forever versus standing seen on the upper threshold.

entries.name: The Day-House Almoners
entries.description: Broth-keepers and ration clerks torn between feeding anyone at the back step or demanding a clean ration ticket first.

entries.name: The Mute Cantors
entries.description: Former false-sun choristers who slipped down below: some keep the old cadence in secret, others seek to break the pitch for good.

entries.name: Witnesses of the Seam
entries.description: Runners and binders along the Ophite seam arguing whether to wait quietly unseen or cut the Dominion stamp open directly.
